headline: Second quiet day in a row; the board stays frozen
body: Another completely quiet day. No events were scored for a second day running, so the endings only drifted as earlier stories faded, by 0.02 at most. With no fresh news to push back, the darker tilt from the Pentagon's classified-network AI deals largely stays in place, and Enslaved God keeps the top spot. Horizon Balance remains +1.28.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Protector God -0.02 and Enslaved God -0.02.
